name: § 4, after indent 8 – 28/2
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common foreign and security policy – 2024 annual report
part_text: – the brutal Israeli military campaign carried out against the people of Gaza, which has resulted in the deaths of over 60 000 people – the majority of whom are women and children – and has caused widespread displacement, injury and starvation, which constitute gross violations of international law and the crime of genocide against the Palestinian people;
